description: Reuses commit-bound task validation evidence during serialized worktree integration and replaces unconditional complete combined-tree validation with a deterministic bounded gate and conservative escalation rules.
delta: Completion handoffs bind validation commands and success evidence to validated task/base commits and declare integration surfaces. Integration reuses unchanged-base evidence, records deterministic independence for advanced main, always runs git diff --check plus an optional declared smoke command, and escalates to full validation only for explicit or material interaction risk while preserving review and forge gates.
verification: decision-table and temporary-repository tests cover evidence reuse, advanced-main comparisons, stale commits, optional smoke behavior, escalation, and clean abort
a clean upgrade from 1.1.42 installs all v2/v3/v5 integration-evidence capabilities while preserving consumer-owned text outside protected regions
